verdict: Lead volume is decent for peak season, but cost per lead sits mid-pack and booking data is missing.
diagnosis: Instagram lead ads produced 54 leads at roughly $145 each — near the industry median but reliant on a single channel with no pipeline visibility.

signals.headline: 54 leads at $145 each
signals.detail: Instagram Instant Form drove 54 leads on $7,835 spend. Cost per lead lands in the middle of industry ranges.

signals.headline: 12 new 5-star reviews this period
signals.detail: Review flow is strong and averages five stars. This directly helps local ad placement and consumer trust.

signals.headline: 71 phone calls from Google profile
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 71 calls and 96 direction requests. Local search is quietly a major lead source.

signals.headline: Instagram reach hit 4,261 accounts
signals.detail: Organic reach is modest at 4,261 with only 12 new followers. Social presence is not compounding yet.

signals.headline: Zero booking or revenue data tracked
signals.detail: No pipeline data means we cannot see which leads become paying jobs. Every recommendation below depends on fixing this.
